T-235 is built, deployed with follow-ups switched off, and in review; it is not pushed to origin. Probe-tantra-reminders passes 91 of 91 against the simulator, and the nurture and lane probes still pass.

decisions.decision: Start T-235 now. T-234's code is merged and deployed, so its missing Tantra key no longer blocks this build. Extend the T-234 'Create reminder campaigns' admin action with two draft campaigns, 'Missed today: replay' and 'Low engagement nudge'. Hook pullAttendance in cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts: for each non-test registrant of that cohort day, a missing zoom_attendance row means no-show and a zoom_engagement score below the threshold means low engagement. Rewrite the contact through /contacts/import with replay_url, replay_passcode, next_session_join and day, then append via POST /email-campaigns/:id/contacts. Claim each (attendee, day, kind) in a new D1 table before sending so it runs once. Add an engagement_nudge_threshold setting, default 40 (no real cohort data yet), editable in Cohort Settings and to be revisited after the first cohort's data. Extend probe-tantra-reminders.mjs with no-show and low-engagement attendees, a second run that appends nobody, and the thresholds UI check. Merge, apply the migration and deploy with the feature off until the key is saved, then move to review.

decisions.decision: Do not rebuild: most of T-235 is already in the working tree, but the board still shows queue with no build log. Present: cloud/src/followups.ts, followup-copy.ts, migration 0024_followups.sql, the runFollowups hook at zoom-pro.ts:615, the admin routes in index.ts, the tantra_followups "0" default and engagement_nudge_threshold in settings.ts, and probe cases. Finish from there. 1) Run git status and log; commit anything uncommitted. 2) Confirm the threshold is shown and editable in the Cohort Settings UI; I could not confirm this, so add it if missing. 3) Start vendor-sim and run app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs. It must show a no-show appended once with the right replay_url, a low-engagement attendee appended to the nudge campaign, and a second run appending nobody. Fix any failure. 4) Check whether 0024 is applied remotely; apply it if not. Deploy the Worker with tantra_followups at 0. 5) Log the probe result and Worker version, then set status to review. The live test waits on the T-337 key; do not open a new ask.
